title: The Expert — EN/PT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Portuguese German language learning stately dry comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, stately and measured]
He spent forty years becoming the world's leading expert
On something
He is, by a considerable margin
The world's leading expert

[Verse 1 - English]
He began in 1974 with genuine enthusiasm
By 1991 he was considered very knowledgeable
By 2014 he was the only person still actively interested
He considered this to be a sign of dedication
He presents his findings at conferences of one
His wife listens for what she considers an appropriate amount of time
He is writing a book
The publisher has not been in touch recently

[Verse 2 - Português]
Ele passou quarenta anos tornando-se o maior especialista do mundo
(He spent forty years becoming the world's leading expert)
Em algo que parou de importar silenciosamente
(In something that has quietly stopped mattering)
Ele apresenta suas descobertas em conferências de uma pessoa
(He presents his findings at conferences of one)
Sua esposa ouve pelo que considera um tempo apropriado
(His wife listens for what she considers appropriate time)
Ele está escrevendo um livro
(He is writing a book)
A editora não entrou em contato recentemente
(The publisher has not been in touch recently)
Ele considera isso paciência editorial
(He considers this editorial patience)

[Chorus - Deutsch]
Er ist der führende Experte der Welt
(He is the world's leading expert)
Für etwas über das niemand mehr fragt
(For something no one asks about anymore)
Er ist der führende Experte der Welt
(He is the world's leading expert)
Für etwas das aufgehört hat zu existieren
(For something that has quietly stopped existing)
Bei Konferenzen für eine Person präsentiert er seine Erkenntnisse
(At conferences of one he presents his findings)
Er ist der führende Experte
(He is the world's leading expert)
Mit großem Abstand
(By a considerable margin)

[Bridge - all three]
He was asked what the second-leading expert thought
Ele foi perguntado o que o segundo especialista pensava
Er wurde gefragt was der zweite Experte denkt
There isn't one — Não há um — Es gibt keinen
He said this without any apparent feeling
Ele disse isso sem nenhum sentimento aparente
Er sagte dies ohne erkennbares Gefühl

[Outro]
He is, by a considerable margin, the world's leading expert
Ele é, com grande vantagem, o maior especialista do mundo
Er ist mit großem Abstand der führende Experte der Welt
